clips.title: The story
paras: At Brewnall Village, Rejold Barleybrew sends a fresh barrel of Shimmer Stout to his brother Wellart. Wellart guards the pass toward Loch Modan, where a cold post makes a strong drink welcome.

Rejold Barleybrew has perfected Shimmer Stout with shimmering fronds gathered from Dun Morogh’s icy crags. His family tends the vats and kegs of Brewnall Village, but his brother Wellart chose life as a Mountaineer. Rejold knows how lonely frontier guard duty can be, so he sends a fresh barrel with passing travelers. It is a favor between brothers and a chance to test the brew.

Wellart Barleybrew guards the South Gate Pass into Loch Modan from the southern tower. High in the pass, Mountaineers face bitter winds and occasional beast attacks while watching over travelers on the mountain road. Wellart is running low on drink and restless for excitement. Shimmer Stout packs quite a punch, he finds, and seems to brighten his vision in the dim mountain night.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout. He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.
He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.
Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, Shaman! And what business takes you all the way out here?
Something exciting, I hope. I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh. Whoa! This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes. I feel like I can see in the dark!
